capabilities: Create weekly workout routines from scratch or templates
Log guided or manual sessions with weight, time and interval exercises
Run timers and stopwatch for warm-up, stretching, sets and rest
Record body weight, size and BMI measurements
View per-routine and global statistics, history and calendars
extras: README and manifest are in Spanish. The manifest carries a warning that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Data is stored as JSON inside Markdown notes in a configurable vault folder (gym-stone by default), and the plugin writes data files directly without .bak backups.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan gym routines, time workout sessions and track exercise progression and body measurements inside a vault.
summary: Gym workout tracker that plans weekly routines, logs guided or manual sessions and body measurements, and shows progress in calendars and statistics.
